question: After Cilician troops entered Antioch and installed Raymond-Roupen as prince, what was the next dated event in which the holder of the principality of Antioch changed?
criterion: a change in who held the princely title of Antioch (seizing, losing, regaining or ceasing to hold it)
why_needs_multiple: Đáp án là mốc kế tiếp sau mốc neo trong cùng tiêu chí; cần hai mốc.

gold_events.text: Cilician troops entered Antioch; Bohemond lost the principality to Raymond-Roupen.
Regained the principality of Antioch after Raymond-Roupen was forced out.

question: Among the dated events in the timeline, list the events in which his eldest son Raymond was killed, or his son Philip was married, imprisoned, or killed, in chronological order.
why_needs_multiple: Bốn mốc về hai người con (Raymond và Philip) theo đúng tiêu chí; cần đủ cả bốn.
criterion: his eldest son Raymond was killed, or his son Philip was married, imprisoned, or killed

gold_events.text: Eldest son Raymond murdered by Assassins at Tortosa.
Son Philip married Isabella of Cilicia; Bohemond had accepted the offer.
Son Philip captured and imprisoned by Constantine of Baberon
Son Philip murdered in prison; Bohemond could not prevent it.

question: How many calendar years passed between Bohemond's later meeting with Emperor Frederick II in Acre, which came after the Cyprus gathering, and his death (counted by calendar year)?
why_needs_multiple: Hai mốc có tên (gặp lại Frederick II ở Acre và qua đời), mốc qua đời chỉ có tháng nên đếm theo năm lịch.

gold_events.text: Met Frederick II again in Acre.
Died in March 1233, a few weeks before the papal confirmation of his treaty.
